developerBrief:
## Developer Brief — Implement Node.js MCP server with KB tools
**Spec Reference:** Section 2, 3, 4
### Context
This is the core implementation of the FORGE KB MCP Server. It replaces scattered bedrock-agent-runtime calls across FIRM, NEXUS, and FAIT with a centralized, authenticated gateway.
### Scope
- Node.js server with Express.js and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
- HTTP POST /mcp for JSON-RPC tool calls
- GET /mcp/sse for SSE transport
- 5 KB tools: search_kb, list_kbs, add_to_kb, get_kb_metadata, get_job_status
- Entra OAuth validation on every request
- Auto-scoping filters for Personal/Team KBs
- CORS configuration for *.fortressam.ai origins
### Technical Notes
- Follow FIP MCP async contract: return job_id immediately, poll with get_job_status
- Use SSEServerTransport from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk for SSE endpoint
- Implement KB inventory as config file/constants (see spec Section 3)
- Security filters are enforced by server, not optional
### Dependencies
- ECR repository and ECS infrastructure
- IAM roles with bedrock-agent-runtime permissions
- CloudFlare route configuration
### Open Questions
- Confirm container port (3000 vs 8080) for ALB target group configuration

description:
## Developer Brief — Implement Entra OAuth token validation
**Spec Reference:** Section 4
### Context
Every request to /mcp endpoints must validate Entra OAuth bearer tokens to ensure only authenticated FIP users can access KB operations.
### Scope
- Bearer token extraction from Authorization header
- JWT signature verification against Entra JWKS endpoint
- Validation of aud, tid, and expiration claims
- Token claims extraction (oid, groups, roles) for scoping
- Middleware function to protect MCP endpoints
### Technical Notes
- Use jsonwebtoken + jwks-rsa libraries for validation
- Cache JWKS responses to avoid excessive calls to Entra
- Return 401 for missing/invalid tokens, 403 for insufficient permissions
- Extract user_id from oid claim for Personal KB scoping
### Dependencies
- ENTRA_TENANT_ID and ENTRA_CLIENT_ID environment variables
### Open Questions
- None
acceptanceCriteria:
- [ ] Authorization header Bearer token extraction implemented
- [ ] JWT signature verified against Entra JWKS endpoint
- [ ] aud claim validated against ENTRA_CLIENT_ID
- [ ] tid claim validated against ENTRA_TENANT_ID
- [ ] Token expiration checked on every request
- [ ] Claims (oid, groups, roles) extracted for downstream use
- [ ] 401 returned for invalid tokens, 403 for insufficient permissions
testedByTitles: TC: Given valid Entra token, When validating JWT, Then extracts claims successfully
TC: Given expired token, When validating JWT, Then returns 401 unauthorized
TC: Given invalid aud claim, When validating JWT, Then returns 401 unauthorized
TC: Given missing Authorization header, When processing request, Then returns 401 unauthorized

description:
## Developer Brief — Implement the search_kb tool
**Spec Reference:** Section 3.1
### Context
The search_kb tool is the primary KB retrieval method, replacing direct bedrock-agent-runtime calls across FIP applications.
### Scope
- JSON-RPC tool implementation for search_kb
- bedrock-agent-runtime:Retrieve API integration
- Auto-scoping filters by KB type (Personal, Team, Project)
- Entitlement validation for KB access
- Response formatting with content, metadata, relevance scores
### Technical Notes
- Security filters are mandatory and injected by server, not optional
- Personal KB: auto-inject user_id from token.oid
- Team KB: validate team membership in FAIT DB
- Project KB: validate project access permissions
- NEXUS and Corp KBs: org-wide access, no filters
### Dependencies
- Bedrock IAM permissions for Retrieve operation
- KB inventory configuration with all KB IDs
### Open Questions
- Team memberships table schema pending FAIT v2 DB design

- [ ] JSON-RPC search_kb tool accepts query, kb_id, top_k, filters parameters
- [ ] Calls bedrock-agent-runtime:Retrieve with proper scoping filters
- [ ] Auto-injects user_id filter for Personal KB (ZCEZCJGHQC, PBKCTCPNUU)
- [ ] Validates team membership for Team KB access
- [ ] Returns formatted results with content, metadata, relevance_score
- [ ] Enforces read entitlements before executing search
- [ ] Returns 403 for unauthorized KB access attempts

## Developer Brief — Implement the list_kbs tool
**Spec Reference:** Section 3.2
### Context
The list_kbs tool returns the KBs a user is entitled to access, supporting both DB-based entitlements and fallback static config.
### Scope
- JSON-RPC tool implementation for list_kbs
- KB entitlement lookup from DB table or fallback config
- Return KB metadata with read/write permissions

- Special handling for NEXUS KB (always accessible)
### Technical Notes
- Priority order: DB table first, fallback to static config
- NEXUS KB (WHB6WU9CVW) always returned as read-only for authenticated users
- Group entitlements from token.groups claim merged with user-specific entitlements
- Return kb_type classification (corp, personal, team, project, nexus)
### Dependencies
- FAIT v2 DB kb_entitlements table (when available)
- Fallback entitlements config file
### Open Questions
- KB entitlements table pending FAIT v2 DB creation

description:
## Developer Brief — Implement the add_to_kb tool
**Spec Reference:** Section 3.3
### Context
The add_to_kb tool enables async content ingestion to KBs, replacing direct StartIngestionJob calls in FIRM and other services.
### Scope
- JSON-RPC tool implementation for add_to_kb
- bedrock-agent-runtime:StartIngestionJob API integration
- Write entitlement validation
- Metadata validation (source, created_by required)
- Async job ID return for polling with get_job_status
### Technical Notes
- Returns immediately with job_id, does not wait for completion
- Validates write entitlements before initiating ingestion
- Requires metadata.source and metadata.created_by fields
- NEXUS and Corp KBs require forge-kb-admin role for writes
- Project KB requires project_id in metadata
### Dependencies
- Bedrock IAM permissions for StartIngestionJob
- KB data source configuration for S3 vs direct ingestion
### Open Questions
- S3 trigger vs direct StartIngestionJob - depends on KB setup
acceptanceCriteria:
- [ ] JSON-RPC add_to_kb tool accepts kb_id, content, metadata parameters
- [ ] Validates write entitlement for target KB
- [ ] Requires metadata.source and metadata.created_by fields
- [ ] Calls bedrock-agent-runtime:StartIngestionJob
- [ ] Returns job_id immediately without waiting
- [ ] Restricts NEXUS/Corp KB writes to forge-kb-admin role
- [ ] Validates project_id in metadata for Project KBs

description:
## Developer Brief — Implement get_kb_metadata and get_job_status tools
**Spec Reference:** Section 3.4, 3.5
### Context
These tools provide KB statistics and async job polling capabilities for the FIP MCP async contract.
### Scope
- get_kb_metadata: KB stats using GetKnowledgeBase + ListIngestionJobs
- get_job_status: Universal async polling for job_ids from add_to_kb
- Read entitlement validation for get_kb_metadata
- Job tracking system (in-memory for MVP)
### Technical Notes
- get_kb_metadata derives last_updated from most recent completed ingestion job
- get_job_status implements FIP MCP async contract for all future async tools
- In-memory job tracking acceptable for MVP single-container deployment
- Returns standard status values: queued, running, complete, failed
### Dependencies
- Bedrock IAM permissions for GetKnowledgeBase, ListIngestionJobs, GetIngestionJob
### Open Questions
- None
acceptanceCriteria:
- [ ] get_kb_metadata returns kb_id, kb_type, document_count, last_updated, data_source_id
- [ ] get_kb_metadata calls GetKnowledgeBase and ListIngestionJobs APIs
- [ ] get_kb_metadata validates read entitlements before execution
- [ ] get_job_status accepts job_id and returns status, result, error, percent_complete
- [ ] get_job_status polls GetIngestionJob for KB ingestion jobs
- [ ] Job tracking system maintains job_id to job_type mapping

TC: Given job_id from add_to_kb, When get_job_status called, Then returns current ingestion status

The MCP server needs HTTP POST for JSON-RPC tool calls and SSE endpoint for server-initiated notifications.

- JSON-RPC 2.0 standard compliance for tool calls
### Dependencies
- CloudFlare SSE configuration (timeout, buffering)
- Authentication middleware for protected endpoints
### Open Questions
- None

developerBrief:
## Developer Brief — Migrate existing FIP services to use fip-mcp
**Spec Reference:** Section 7
### Context
After fip-mcp is deployed and stable, existing FIP services need to migrate from direct bedrock-agent-runtime calls to using the centralized MCP server.
### Scope
- File migration WIs against FIRM, NEXUS, and FAIT v1 projects
- Replace StartIngestionJob calls in FIRM with add_to_kb tool
- Replace Retrieve calls in NEXUS with search_kb tool
- Replace KB retrieval in FAIT v1 with search_kb tool
- Update services to use Entra OAuth tokens for MCP authentication
### Technical Notes
- This is NOT part of the initial fip-mcp build - file as follow-on WIs
- FAIT v2 will use fip-mcp from the start (see FAIT v2 spec Section 7)
- Coordinate FAIT v1 migration with FAIT v2 timeline to avoid duplicate work
- Services will need MCP client libraries or HTTP calls to /mcp endpoint
### Dependencies
- fip-mcp service deployed and stable
- CloudFlare routing configured
- Services have access to Entra OAuth tokens
### Open Questions
- FAIT v1 migration priority depends on FAIT v2 retirement timeline

title: As a project manager, I want to file migration WIs for FIRM so that it uses fip-mcp instead of direct Bedrock calls
description:
## [Task Name]
**Before:** FIRM's firm-transcriber Batch container calls bedrock-agent-runtime:StartIngestionJob directly to push meeting summaries to Personal KB
**After:** FIRM uses fip-mcp add_to_kb tool with proper authentication and error handling
**Migration Steps:**
1. File WI against FIRM project for bedrock-agent-runtime migration
2. Update firm-transcriber to call fip-mcp /mcp endpoint instead of AWS SDK
3. Implement Entra OAuth token acquisition for MCP authentication
4. Replace StartIngestionJob calls with add_to_kb tool calls
5. Update error handling to use fip-mcp response format
6. Test with Personal KB ingestion workflow
**Validation:** Meeting summaries successfully ingest to Personal KB via fip-mcp with same functionality as direct calls
**Rollback:** Revert to direct bedrock-agent-runtime calls if fip-mcp fails
acceptanceCriteria:
- [ ] WI filed against FIRM project for fip-mcp migration
- [ ] Migration scope includes firm-transcriber Batch container updates
- [ ] Entra OAuth integration specified for MCP authentication
- [ ] StartIngestionJob calls replaced with add_to_kb tool calls
- [ ] Error handling updated for MCP response format

title: As a project manager, I want to evaluate FAIT v1 migration priority so that we avoid duplicate work with FAIT v2
description:
## [Task Name]
**Before:** FAIT v1 has direct KB retrieval calls in backend for agent context injection
**After:** Decision on whether to migrate FAIT v1 or skip in favor of FAIT v2 timeline
**Migration Steps:**
1. Coordinate with FAIT v2 project timeline and retirement plan
2. Assess FAIT v1 usage and remaining lifecycle
3. If migration warranted: file WI against FAIT v1 for bedrock-agent-runtime migration
4. If skipping: document decision and ensure FAIT v2 uses fip-mcp from start
5. Update FAIT v2 spec Section 7 MCP gateway architecture references
**Validation:** Clear decision documented on FAIT v1 migration with timeline coordination
**Rollback:** FAIT v1 continues with direct bedrock-agent-runtime calls until retirement
acceptanceCriteria:
- [ ] FAIT v2 timeline and FAIT v1 retirement plan reviewed
- [ ] Migration vs skip decision documented with rationale
- [ ] If migrating: WI filed against FAIT v1 project
- [ ] If skipping: FAIT v2 MCP integration confirmed
- [ ] Decision coordinates with FAIT v2 Phase 1 timeline

parentTitle: As a developer, I want to implement Entra OAuth token validation so that only authorized users can access KB tools
title: TC: Given valid Entra token, When validating JWT, Then extracts claims successfully
description:
**Given:** Valid Entra OAuth JWT with correct aud, tid, and expiration
**When:** Token validation middleware processes the request
**Then:** Claims (oid, groups, roles) extracted and request proceeds
**Tested By:** As a developer, I want to implement Entra OAuth token validation so that only authorized users can access KB tools
rationale: Enforces §4 auth requirement: valid tokens must have claims extracted for downstream scoping.
